- Aditya will run the environment-specific checklist; Rafael will cover account/contract questions.
- Ive attached a draft SOW and will include a calendar invite once you confirm which option works.

Please reply with the option you prefer and any blackout dates for the next 3 weeks. If helpful, list 2	63 concrete slots (your timezone) and well map them to the rotation.
